user.title: Connect Jeelink
user.description: Configure the serial connection to your Jeelink. After setup, open Configure on the integration to add LaCrosse sensors.

data_description.device: Usually /dev/ttyUSB0. Prefer a stable /dev/serial/by-id/... path when available.

abort.already_configured: This serial device is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The selected device does not match this configuration entry.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The serial connection was updated successfully.

raw_telegram_diagnostics.title: Raw telegram diagnostics
raw_telegram_diagnostics.description: Enable diagnostics to inspect raw radio telegrams received by the JeeLink in the Home Assistant logs. Raw data is only logged when DEBUG logging is enabled. This feature helps investigate unknown or incorrect radio IDs.

data_description.raw_telegram_diagnostics: Disabled by default. Changing this setting reloads the integration. To display raw telegrams, DEBUG logging must also be enabled for custom_components.lacrosse_jeelink.receiver.

add_sensor.title: Add LaCrosse sensor manually
add_sensor.description: Add a physical LaCrosse sensor using its radio ID and specify whether it supports humidity.

data_description.radio_id: The ID received by Jeelink for this sensor.
data_description.expire_after: Seconds without a packet before the device is marked unavailable.
data_description.has_humidity: Enable for sensors measuring both temperature and humidity. Disable for temperature-only sensors. This selection will not be overridden automatically.
data_description.multi_channel: Enable for sensors with separate internal and external temperature probes, such as the Technoline TX25TP-IT. Two temperature entities will be created and humidity will be disabled.

scan_sensor.title: Search for LaCrosse sensors
scan_sensor.description: All LaCrosse sensors received by the Jeelink since the integration was started are shown here. Select a new sensor.

add_discovered_sensor.title: Add discovered sensor
add_discovered_sensor.description: Radio ID {radio_id} was discovered. Current values: {temperature} °C / {humidity} %. Enter a name and verify whether the sensor supports humidity.

data_description.expire_after: Seconds without a packet before the device is marked unavailable.
data_description.has_humidity: The suggested setting is based on the most recently received packet. Please verify it against the sensor model. Your confirmed selection will be preserved.
data_description.multi_channel: Enable for sensors with separate internal and external temperature probes, such as the Technoline TX25TP-IT. Two temperature entities will be created and humidity will be disabled.

replace_battery.title: Battery replacement / Reassign radio ID
replace_battery.description: Select an existing sensor. The integration will search for a new radio ID while keeping the existing Home Assistant device and entities.

replace_battery_scan.title: Detect new radio ID
replace_battery_scan.description: Selected sensor: {sensor_name} (current radio ID: {radio_id}). Remove and reinsert its batteries. The integration will look for newly received radio packets with the new-battery flag. Only packets received after starting the search will be considered.

replace_battery_confirm.title: Confirm new radio ID
replace_battery_confirm.description: A possible new radio ID was detected for {sensor_name}. Current ID: {old_radio_id}. New ID: {new_radio_id}. Confirm only if you are certain this is the correct physical sensor.

error.name_exists: A sensor with this name already exists.
error.radio_id_exists: This radio ID is already configured.
error.no_new_radio_id: No suitable new radio ID has been detected yet. Replace the batteries and try again.
error.multiple_radio_ids: Multiple possible radio IDs were detected. The sensor cannot be assigned automatically.
error.sensor_not_found: The selected sensor no longer exists.
error.radio_id_changed: The sensor configuration has changed. Restart the reassignment.

abort.no_discovered_sensors: No LaCrosse sensors have been received yet. Wait a moment or remove and reinsert the batteries in the sensor you want to discover.
abort.sensor_already_configured: This LaCrosse sensor is already configured.
